title: Camp Residents
imageAlt: Camp reference image for resident notes
summary: The unidentified people living at The Camp, notable for repeated routines and almost-human behavior.
intro: The Camp Residents make The Camp feel populated, but they also make it feel performed. They are polite, practical, and slightly wrong.

details.label: Shared behavior
details.value: Repeated routines, avoided topics, rehearsed kindness

details.label: Story role
details.value: Social unease and evidence of a larger system

facts: The residents do not all behave the same way.
Some are helpful enough that the Player feels bad suspecting them.
Their routines connect The Camp to the Other Camp.

sections.heading: Overview
paragraphs: The Camp Residents are the background cast of The Camp. They cook, repair, patrol, and speak with the Player, but their behavior does not fully pass as natural.
They create uncertainty instead of immediate danger. The Player depends on them for supplies or information while noticing that their reactions are too synchronized.
The residents become one of the clearest signs that The Camp is part of a controlled pattern.
items: Primary function: make safety feel conditional.
Common detail: conversation stops when certain topics are mentioned.
Reveal thread: some residents are copied from missing humans.
